$comment: Pipelinq's setup wizard counts as answered on an instance with the Zuiddrecht set, so Pieter opens his start page, not the wizard. The reporting currency is the one required step (SetupController::status() marks setup complete once it is set); setup_dismissed_version records that the wizard was closed at manifest setup.version 1, so the optional steps (till, integrations) do not open it again. A later setup.version opens it once more, as for any instance.
